items.description: One locomotion kit — a world-definition row naming a way of moving: the body motion program it runs under, the motion tuning its bodies compile, its producer arguments, and its action-lane bindings. Every game-flavored movement noun is a row of this data, never an engine enum; the census echo prints these names. Name is the kit's kebab-case name (the census echo token); BodyMotionProgram names the body motion program the kit's bodies execute; Motion is the locomotion tuning the kit's bodies compile (a seat's profile speeds still override its speed fields) — see WorldMotion.

moveSpeed.description: Locomotion speed in world units per second — the profileless fallback a stand-in advances on (a seated player reads its live profile's speed instead, so identity.motion stays real-time).

turnSpeed.description: Turn speed in radians per second (the profileless fallback counterpart to MoveSpeed).

sprintMultiplier.description: The held-sprint speed multiplier, applied while SprintChannel reads held; 1 is a no-op.

response.description: The velocity-response table (see MotionResponse) planar velocity converges through, or null (the default) when Dynamics shapes it instead — exactly one of the two is authored, so null means "not authored" to that rule and is never coalesced here. An authored empty table is distinct: it snaps planar velocity instantly. The one place null reads as the empty table is WorldMotionTuningFactory.Compile.

items.description: One row of a kit's velocity-response table: how fast planar velocity converges on the commanded target while Gate holds. Rows evaluate in order, first match wins; a body matching no row snaps instantly (the built-in behavior, and the behavior of a kit with no table). The gate reuses the action-lane predicate vocabulary — only body-fact kinds (now/recently/all) are admissible.

engageRate.description: The convergence rate (world units/second²) while the stick is deflected — acceleration toward the commanded target.

releaseRate.description: The convergence rate while the stick is centered — deceleration toward rest (the coast).

gate.description: The body-fact predicate that must hold for this row to win, or null for the always-row (permitted only as the final row).

dynamics.description: The dynamics row a second-order follower shapes planar velocity through instead of Response, or null (the default) for the response table. Exactly one of the two is authored.

sprintChannel.description: The declared channel name a body reads while held (not edge-triggered — a continuous multiplier, unlike the press/release ActionSpec vocabulary) to apply SprintMultiplier, or null (the default) for a kit with no sprint capability. Resolved to an ordinal once, alongside every other kit-channel name, by Compile — an unresolvable name (validator-refused already) reads as "no sprint" rather than throwing.

moveFrame.description: Which frame MoveAdvance/MoveStrafe resolve in. Heading explicitly rotates the commanded planar target by the body's own integrated heading. World (the default) takes the two channels as axes already in world frame — the seat's client composes the camera yaw into the submitted intent before it ever reaches the wire, so the sim never reads a camera pose (determinism: no camera state enters simulation).

facingSnap.description: Under World only: whether the body's drawn ATTITUDE snaps to Atan2 of the commanded planar direction every tick that carries input (no turn-rate ramp, no skid) — the body angles toward its travel, a strafe included — while its HEADING (the Turn role's integral, WorldBody.FixedYaw, the frame a Heading pair moves in) holds, and the attitude returns to the heading the tick movement stops. Only the Face roles turn the heading itself. Ignored under Heading, where attitude is the integrated heading by construction. true is the default.

moveSpeedEnvelope.description: The inclusive bound a seated player's live profile speed (and the profileless MoveSpeed fallback) is clamped to at seat time, or null (the default) for no bound — a feel-pinned world authors this to keep a seat's speed inside its own kit's envelope regardless of what the player's identity requests. null reproduces today's unclamped behavior exactly; Min == Max pins the effective speed outright; a narrower-than-wide-open range still admits a bounded profile override. See MotionScalarEnvelope.

max.description: The greatest admitted value (inclusive) — WorldDefinitionValidator refuses Max < Min by name. Equal to Min pins the scalar outright regardless of what a profile requests.

holds.description: The ordered list of what may hold this body — see WorldHold — read by the ResolveHold/ApplyHold operations. A Motion-kind kit authoring none refuses validation by name: the hold list is the only spelling of a vertical channel, so a kit with no vertical law of its own still authors one row of kind None.

items.description: One authored hold row of a kit's ordered Holds list — what may hold this body, in preference order. ResolveHold keeps the hold it has while its surface is still there and the same face, and otherwise takes the first row the world offers; ApplyHold applies Hold.

name.description: The row's name, unique within the list — the body.hold read-back token.

bond.description: Whether this row needs a surface (Surface) or holds the body where it is (Free).

hold.description: What holds the body once the row is taken.

cone.description: The inclusive angle band, in degrees, between an admitted surface normal and gravity-up: [0, 60] is floors, [60, 120] walls, [0, 180] everything. Required for Surface, refused for Free.

grip.description: The inward pull, world units per second, under Grip. Applied as a positional standoff, so it closes a gap the surface opens without ever pushing the body through it.

lift.description: The fraction of gravity cancelled under Lift: 1 hovers, 0.5 halves the fall.

speed.description: The travel speed along the hold's tangent plane, world units per second, or null to ride the kit's own resolved move speed.

reach.description: How far a surface row's probes search, world units. Required positive for Surface.

upLean.description: How far the body's up axis blends from gravity-up toward the surface normal, in [0, 1].

forward.description: Where the hold's frame takes its forward direction when the surface leaves it free.

onDrive.description: Whether driving into an admitted face takes this row with no channel press.

driveAlignment.description: The least alignment, in [0, 1], between the commanded direction and the face's inward normal before OnDrive takes it. Inert without it.

release.description: The declared channel name whose held read drops this row, or null for a row no channel can drop.

spend.description: What the row spends while held, or null for a row that spends nothing.

ratePerSecond.description: The positive rate the slot drains at, per second.

medium.description: The medium's own displacement law. Required for Medium and refused on every other bond.

buoyancy.description: The idle vertical drift velocity below the bob band, signed (u/s).

surfaceSettleRate.description: The proportional settle gain toward the float line (1/s).

floatDepth.description: The float line's depth below the medium surface, and the bob band's half-width (u).

gravity.description: The vertical arc this row falls under. Required for Gravity and Lift; refused for Grip, None, and every Medium row.

rise.description: The downward acceleration while rising (u/s²) — the floaty top of the arc.

fall.description: The downward acceleration while falling (u/s²) — the snappy descent (heavier than the rise). The world's own solved gravity field, where one is authored, overrides the MAGNITUDE but keeps this row's rise-to-fall ratio as the arc's asymmetry.

terminal.description: The terminal fall speed the descent is clamped to (u/s).

thrust.description: The fraction of the kit's resolved move speed the MoveUp role commands vertically while this row holds, in every bond — 0 (the default) is no vertical thrust at all, 1 is fully isotropic. A non-Medium row commanding thrust takes the vertical channel outright for the tick, clearing the ballistic carry; a medium row folds it into the medium's own displacement before that law's convergence runs.

drive.description: The anisotropic drive row — see WorldDrive — read by the ResolveDriveFrame/ShapeDriveVelocity operations, or null (the default) for a kit whose planar velocity is the isotropic shaping's alone. A program selecting either drive operation against a kit authoring no row refuses by name through the Drive tuning facet.

accel.description: The longitudinal convergence rate (u/s²) while throttle commands more speed.

brake.description: The longitudinal convergence rate (u/s²) while back-throttle opposes forward travel.

coast.description: The longitudinal convergence rate (u/s²) toward rest with throttle centered, and the decay rate while over the commanded speed (the post-boost bleed).

grip.description: The lateral convergence rate (u/s²) toward zero slip — traction. Lower is slidier.

steerReferenceSpeed.description: The longitudinal speed (u/s) at which steering authority peaks; authority rises linearly from zero at standstill.

steerFalloff.description: The fraction of full steering authority remaining at the kit's resolved move speed, in [0, 1]; authority falls linearly from the reference speed.

reverseSpeed.description: The reverse speed (u/s) full back-throttle converges on from rest; 0 forbids reversing.

pitchRate.description: The pitch rate (rad/s) the Pitch channel commands; 0 locks the frame planar (the ground and hover variants). Positive selects the flying variant's pitched facing, clamped inside the integrator so the frame can never flip past vertical.

drift.description: The held low-traction state, or null (the default) for a kit that cannot drift.

channel.description: The declared composition channel name read while held.

grip.description: The lateral convergence rate (u/s²) replacing Grip while the channel reads held — the deliberate low-traction state. Required positive.

steerScale.description: The steering-authority multiplier while drifting (the tightened drift arc). Required positive.

additionalProperties.description: One kit's named arguments for an authored producer program.

scalars.description: Fixed-point scalar arguments keyed by instruction-defined name.

channels.description: Authored channel arguments keyed by instruction-defined name.

additionalProperties.description: A lane's full binding: the press trigger and the release trigger. What a channel does is this data — the engine implements only the facts, predicates, and effects.

onRelease.description: The falling-edge trigger (evaluated immediately, never latched), or null.

onFact.description: Engine-fact-triggered effect lists evaluated independently of channel edges.

items.description: An authored effect list fired by one engine fact pulse — gated and edged by the same ActionTriggerMode vocabulary a world rule uses.

fact.description: The fact that fires the rule.

gate.description: An additional predicate that must hold beside Fact, or null for none.

mode.description: Whether the trigger fires every tick the condition holds (Level, the default) or once per crossing (Edge). The condition is Fact and Gate together — an edge trigger re-arms only when that conjunction stops holding.

anyOf.description: A sphere resting on the body root.
A capsule whose lower sphere rests on the body root.

endpoint.description: The body-local vector from the lower sphere center to the upper sphere center.

anyOf.description: An oriented box resting on the body root before its local rotation is applied.
The finite primitive bounds emitted by a creation, composed into one compound body collider.

additionalProperties.description: The neutral pad element a Pad entry maps a channel onto. Named after the engine-neutral MachinePadState's own axis/button vocabulary; a pad entry picks exactly one.

assignment.description: The kit→entity assignment policy — ABSENT resolves to Default.
